entries.title: Psalms 61:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker. On a corded instrument. Of David.> Let my cry come to you, O God; let your ears be open to my prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 61:2
segments: From the end of the earth will I send up my cry to you, when my heart is overcome: take me to the rock which is over-high for me.

entries.title: Psalms 61:3
segments: For you have been my secret place, and my high tower from those who made war on me.

entries.title: Psalms 61:4
segments: I will make your tent my resting-place for ever: I will keep myself under the cover of your wings. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 61:5
segments: ¶For you, O God, have made answer to my prayers; you have given me the heritage of those who give honour to your name.

entries.title: Psalms 61:6
segments: You will give the king long life; and make his years go on through the generations.

entries.title: Psalms 61:7
segments: May the seat of his authority be before God for ever; may mercy and righteousness keep him safe.

entries.title: Psalms 61:8
segments: So will I make songs in praise of your name for ever, giving to God that which is right day by day.
